title: Boat Trailer Tongue Weight
short_description: Check tongue weight, axle loads and tow ratings of your boat trailer rig.

guides.title: Boat Fuel and Water Weight per Gallon Chart
guides.description: How much gasoline, diesel and water weigh per gallon, with a chart by tank size and a worked example of how they change trailer tongue weight.

guides.title: Boat Trailer Tongue Weight Calculator and Formula
guides.description: Estimate boat trailer tongue weight from item weights and positions. Formula, worked example, the 7 to 10 percent target and a small calculator.

guides.title: How to Increase Boat Trailer Tongue Weight
guides.description: Four ways to fix low boat trailer tongue weight, with formulas and a worked example. The same math works in reverse for a heavy tongue.
